name: cleanroom_r2e_rdkitplus_novelty_hard_slice_v1
purpose: Test whether the already pre-frozen train-only reaction-novelty replay mechanism can improve the documented reaction-similarity <0.3 R2E capability gap when applied to the current 3139-d RDKit+ cleanroom retriever.
development_benchmarks: clean2023 strict protein+reaction entity-disjoint historical folds 0/1/2 only

candidate_expert.change_from_baseline: reaction-novelty replay only; architecture, RDKit+ features, optimizer, negative mining, seed and all other training parameters remain fixed
candidate_expert.novelty_definition: nearest other fold-train reaction by binary 2048-d DRFP Tanimoto; only fold-train entities are used
candidate_expert.recipe_provenance: threshold=0.7/repeat=1 was frozen before prior outer confirmation (00ad433 / RDKITPLUS_OUTER_EXECUTION_V1); no revealed outer metric is used to choose or modify it

evaluation.metric_contract: Use repository broad-Rhea ranking metrics; Hit@K alone is insufficient.

screening_rule.broad_all_query_guard: Across pooled folds0/1/2 R2E queries, MRR and MAP may not regress by more than 0.002 absolute and Hit@10/20/50 may not regress by more than 0.005 absolute.
screening_rule.selection_scope: Only baseline versus this single pre-frozen novelty candidate is inspected; no threshold/repeat sweep is allowed in v1.
screening_rule.if_pass: Freeze a new deterministic salted strict double-cold confirmation split before materializing its labels; do not use fold3, salted fold6, Enzyme-405, temporal or ReactZyme revealed outer cells as the unbiased confirmation.
screening_rule.if_fail: Reject this expert for <0.3 routing. Do not change threshold or repeat using these results; any new recipe is a new preregistered experiment.

outer_policy: No already revealed outer benchmark may be used for v1 selection or confirmation.
